propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes resolved-status names while DC reconciler reads them from config, creating parity gap

Cloud tenants with non-standard resolved-status names (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete') cannot configure the probe without code changes, causing issues to be misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED
JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list with env override REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES, defaulting to ['Resolved', 'Done', 'Cancelled']
probe.classify_probe_response must resolve the set from config at runtime and fall back to module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES when unset, empty, or malformed
Custom resolved-status sets must be consulted exclusively (not merged with defaults); empty configured lists must trigger fallback to module default
Configuration override must be fully backward compatible: stock tenants with unset jira.resolved_statuses remain unaffected and classify standard status names as PRESENT_RESOLVED
